label: Auto Clear Away
tip: Automatically exit Away mode upon moving or talking.

label: Auto Dismount in Flight
tip: If enabled, your character will automatically dismount before casting while flying.

label: Auto Loot
tip: Sets Auto Looting as the default action when clicking on lootable things. (Looting when this is checked, or Auto Looting when it is not, is performed by holding the Loot Key / Auto Loot Key)

label: Auto Loot Key
tip: Key to use to auto loot.

label: Block Trades
tip: Block all incoming trade requests.

label: Open Loot Window at Mouse
tip: When checked the loot window will open up under the current mouse location.

label: Sticky Targeting
tip: Checking this will prevent the deselection of targets by clicking on the gamefield. Targets can only be cleared by pressing escape or clicking another target.

label: Attack on Assist
tip: Automatically attack a target when you acquire it by using "/assist".

label: Auto Attack/Auto Shot
tip: If enabled, your character will automatically switch between auto attack and auto shot.

label: Auto Self Cast
tip: When this is enabled, friendly target spells that you cast while you have a non friendly target or no target will automatically be self cast.

label: Class Colors in Nameplates
tip: Toggles class colors in the background of Nameplate health bar for enemy players.

label: On Nameplates
tip: If the Name Plate is displayed for your current target, show the enemy cast bar with the target's health bar in the game field.

label: On Targets
tip: Show the spell that your current target is casting.

label: Stop Auto Attack
tip: Stop auto attacking when you switch targets.

label: Target of Target
tip: Toggles the display of the target of your target.

label: Show Target of Target
tip: When the target of your target is shown (with Target of Target on).

label: Self Cast Key
tip: When held this key will allow self casting, even if an enemy is targeted.

label: Focus Cast Key
tip: Key to hold to cast targeted spells on your focus target.

label: Cinematic Subtitles
tip: Enables subtitles during the intro cinematic.

label: Colorblind Mode
tip: Displays unit reactions and item qualities in tooltips and adds additional information to several other interfaces.

label: Detailed Loot Information
tip: Uncheck this to hide individual loot roll messages and only show the winner.

label: Play Aggro Sounds
tip: Enable the playing of alert sounds when aggro advances to a higher level.

label: Rotate Minimap
tip: Check this to rotate the entire minimap instead of the player arrow.

label: Screen Edge Flash
tip: Shows a screen edge flash when you have a fullscreen UI up and you are in combat.

label: Show Aggro Percentages
tip: Check this to show threat on targets as a percentage.

label: Show Clock
tip: Displays the clock button on the minimap.

label: Show Free Bag Space
tip: Displays remaining inventory space on the backpack icon.

label: Show Item Level
tip: Display item level in the tooltip for certain items.

label: Automatic Quest Progress Updates
tip: Quests are automatically watched for 5 minutes when you achieve a quest objective.

label: Automatic Quest Tracking
tip: Automatically track quests with objectives as soon as you obtain them.

label: Instant Quest Text
tip: Check this to make quest text appear instantly.

label: Movable World Map
tip: Enabling this will allow you to move the smaller world map by right-clicking its title bar.

label: Quest Difficulty Color
tip: Color quest titles by difficulty when displayed with the World Map.

label: Wider Objectives Tracker|TInterface\OptionsFrame\UI-OptionsFrame-NewFeatureIcon:0:0:0:-1|t
tip: Increases the width of the Objectives tracker.

label: Auto Join Guild Recruitment Channel
tip: Check this option to automatically join the Guild Recruitment chat channel based upon whether or not you are in a guild.

label: Chat Bubbles
tip: Shows /say and /yell text in speech bubbles above characters' heads.

label: Click to Focus
tip: Clicking anywhere in a Chat Frame will cause it to receive focus.

label: Disable Spam Filter
tip: Disables spam filtering on chat text.

label: Enable Mouse Wheel Scrolling
tip: Check to make the mouse wheel scroll through chat when the cursor is over a chat window.

label: Guild Member Alert
tip: Show a message when your guild members login and logout.

label: Mature Language Filter
tip: Enable mature language filtering.

label: Party Chat Bubbles
tip: Shows party chat text in speech bubbles above party members' heads.

label: Remove Chat Hover Delay
tip: Check to show chat windows immediately upon mouseover.

label: Chat Style
tip: IM Style keeps the chat box open; Classic Style opens it with Enter.

label: New Real ID Conversations
tip: Where new Real ID conversations open.

label: Always Show ActionBars
tip: Check this option to always display extra actionbars.

label: Lock ActionBars
tip: Prevents the user from picking up/dragging spells on the action bar. This function can be bound to a function key in the keybindings interface.

label: Secure Ability Toggle
tip: When selected you will be protected from toggling your abilities off if accidently hitting the button more than once in a short period of time.

label: Nameplates: Allow Overlapping Unit Nameplates
tip: Unit Nameplates can overlap if units are visually in a line. Turn this off to keep each Unit Nameplate seperate from each other.

label: Names: Critters and Vanity Pets
tip: Show critter and vanity pet names in the game world.

label: Names: Enemy Players
tip: Show enemy players' names in the game world.

label: Nameplates: Enemy Units
tip: Turn this on to display Unit Nameplates for enemies.

label: Names: Friendly Players
tip: Show friendly players' names in the game world.

label: Nameplates: Friendly Units
tip: Turn this on to display Unit Nameplates for friendly units

label: Names: Enemy guardians
tip: Show enemy guardian names in the game world.

label: Names: Friendly guardians
tip: Show friendly guardian names in the game world.

label: Nameplates: Enemy guardians
tip: Turn this on to display Unit Nameplates for enemy guardians

label: Nameplates: Friendly guardians
tip: Turn this on to display Unit Nameplates for friendly guardians

label: Names: Guild Names
tip: Show players' guild names in the game world.

label: Names: My Name
tip: Display your character's name in the game world.

label: Names: NPC Names
tip: Show NPC names in the game world.

label: Names: Enemy pets
tip: Show enemy pet names in the game world.

label: Names: Friendly pets
tip: Show friendly pet names in the game world.

label: Nameplates: Enemy pets
tip: Turn this on to display Unit Nameplates for enemy pets

label: Nameplates: Friendly pets
tip: Turn this on to display Unit Nameplates for friendly pets.

label: Names: Titles
tip: Show player titles in the game world.

label: Names: Enemy totems
tip: Show enemy totem names in the game world.

label: Names: Friendly totems
tip: Show friendly totem names in the game world.

label: Nameplates: Enemy totems
tip: Turn this on to display Unit Nameplates for enemy totems

label: Nameplates: Friendly totems
tip: Turn this on to display Unit Nameplates for friendly totems

label: Auras
tip: Shows a message when the player gains or loses an aura.

label: Combat State
tip: Shows a message when you enter or leave combat.

label: Combo Points
tip: Shows the number of combo points you have each time you acquire a new one.

label: Damage Reduction
tip: Shows when you resist taking damage from attacks or spells.

label: Dodges/Parries/Misses
tip: Shows attacks against you that dodge, parry, or miss.

label: Enable My Floating Combat Text
tip: Checking this will enable additional combat messages to appear in the playfield.

label: Energy Gains
tip: Shows all instant gains of mana, rage, and energy.

label: Friendly Healer Names
tip: Shows the name of a friendly caster when they cast a heal spell on you.

label: Healing
tip: Display amount of healing you did to the target.

label: Honor Gained
tip: Shows the honor you gain from killing other players.

label: Low Mana & Health
tip: Shows a message when you fall below 20% mana or health.

label: Periodic Damage
tip: Display damage caused by periodic effects such as Rend and Shadow Word: Pain.

label: Periodic Energy Gains
tip: Shows all periodic gains of mana, rage, and energy.

label: Pet Damage
tip: Show damage caused by your pet.

label: Reactive Spells & Abilities
tip: Shows when reactive class specific abilities and spells become available (e.g. Overpower for warriors).

label: Reputation Changes
tip: Shows a message when the player gains or loses reputation with a faction.

label: Show for other players' targets
tip: Display effects such as Silence and Snare on other players' targets.

label: Target Damage
tip: Display damage numbers over hostile creatures when damaged.

label: Target Effects
tip: Display effects such as Silence and Snare on your target.

label: Combat Text Float Mode
tip: Sets the direction that combat text scrolls.

label: Display Percentages
tip: Always display status text using percentage values.

label: Experience Bar Text
tip: Always display the text on your XP bar.

label: Party
tip: Always display the text on your party's health, mana, rage, or energy bars.

label: Pet
tip: Always display the text on your pet's health, mana, or focus bars.

label: Player
tip: Always display the text on your character's health, mana, rage, or energy bars.

label: Target
tip: Always display the text on your target's health, mana, rage, energy, or focus bars.

label: Arena Enemy Frames
tip: Show enemy unit frames in arenas.

label: Hide Party Interface in Raid
tip: Click this to hide your party's portraits and health bars.

label: Larger Focus Frame
tip: Increases the size of the Focus Frame to that of the Target Frame.

label: Party Members' Pets
tip: Show the portraits of your party members' pets.

label: Party/Arena Background
tip: Show a background behind party members and enemy arena team members.

label: Range in Raid Interface
tip: Show the range of raid members when they are far away by fading out their health bars.

label: Show Cast Bars
tip: Show the spells that players on the enemy arena team are casting.

label: Show Pets
tip: Show the portraits of the pets belonging to the enemy arena team.

label: Auto Follow Speed
tip: Adjust the camera movement speed in Always and Smart following styles.

label: Follow Terrain
tip: Automatically change the camera angle based on the terrain. If your character climbs a slope, the camera will rotate upwards; if you descend, it will rotate downwards.

label: Head Bob
tip: Simulate head bobbing when in first-person perspective.

label: Max Camera Distance
tip: Adjust the maximum distance the camera will follow behind you.

label: Smart Pivot
tip: Lets you free look when the camera is on the ground.

label: Water Collision
tip: Set the camera to be above water when your character is above water, and below water when your character is below water.

label: Camera Following Style
tip: How the camera follows your character.

label: Buff Durations
tip: Toggle text counters for buff durations on and off.

label: Castable Buffs
tip: Show only buffs you can cast on friendly targets. Only applies to raids.

label: Castable Debuffs
tip: Show only the debuffs you applied on enemy targets.

label: Consolidate Buffs
tip: Filters certain buffs into a buff consolidation box. Short term buffs are displayed in the box. Very long term buffs are displayed in the box until they are about to expire.

label: Dispellable Debuffs
tip: Show only debuffs you can dispel on friendly targets. Only applies to raids.

label: Click-to-Move
tip: Use mouse clicks to move your character to destinations.

label: Detect World of Warcraft Gaming Mouse
tip: Enable this option if you have a World of Warcraft Gaming Mouse and you wish to bind keys to the extra buttons.

label: Invert Mouse
tip: Invert the way that the mouse affects camera pitch.

label: Mouse Look Speed
tip: Adjust the speed at which you turn the camera when using mouse look.

label: Mouse Sensitivity
tip: Adjust the speed at which the mouse cursor moves.

label: Click-to-Move Camera Style
tip: Determines the way the camera follows the player while in Click-to-Move mode.

label: Preview Talent Changes
tip: Toggles the ability to preview talents before spending talent points.

label: Use Equipment Manager
tip: Enables the equipment management UI

label: Beginner Tooltips
tip: Show detailed information about various user interface elements. Advanced players may want to turn this off.

label: Display Lua Errors
tip: Shows error messages related to UI functionality.

label: Enhanced Tooltips
tip: Enable detailed tooltips in the lower right hand corner of the screen.

label: Loading Screen Tips
tip: Uncheck this to hide the tip of the day in the load screens.

label: Tutorials
tip: Display tutorials which help introduce you to WoW.

label: Disable Resize
tip: Enable this to prevent resizing the game window.

label: Hardware Cursor
tip: Enable this option for a more responsive cursor unless you have cursor problems.

label: Maximized
tip: Check to maximize window and remove borders.

label: Reduce Input Lag
tip: Enabling this reduces user interface lag, but may drastically reduce frame rates.

label: Triple Buffering
tip: Enables triple buffering of frames when vertical sync is enabled. Selecting triple buffering may even out frame rate spikes, but may also cause slight input lag.

label: UI scale
tip: The current UI scale

label: Use desktop gamma
tip: Use the same gamma settings as your desktop.

label: Use UI Scale
tip: Check to use the UI Scale Slider, uncheck to use the system default scale.

label: Vertical Sync
tip: Synchronizes your framerate to some fraction of your monitor's refresh rate. Enable this if you see excessive screen tearing in game.

label: Windowed Mode
tip: Check to play in a non-fullscreen window. If this is checked the game will use your desktop gamma and you will not be able to adjust it via the slider below.

label: Death Effect
tip: Uncheck to disable glowing effect while in ghost form. Disabling this can sometimes improve performance.

label: Environment Detail
tip: Controls how far you can see objects. Decrease to improve performance.

label: Full-Screen Glow Effect
tip: Enables a full screen effect that softens edges and lighting. Disabling this can sometimes improve performance.

label: Ground Clutter Density
tip: Controls the number of ground clutter items, like grass and foliage. Decrease to improve performance.

label: Ground Clutter Radius
tip: Controls the draw distance of ground clutter items like grass and foliage. Decrease to improve performance.

label: Particle Density
tip: Controls the number of particles used in effects caused by spells, fires, etc. Decrease to improve performance.

label: Player Textures
tip: Controls the resolution of player textures. Decreasing this may slightly improve performance.

label: Projected Textures
tip: Enables the projecting of textures to the environment. Disabling this may greatly improve performance.

label: Shadow Quality
tip: Controls the quality of rendered character and environment shadows. Decrease to improve performance.

label: Specular Lighting
tip: Enables specular highlights on terrain. Disabling this can sometimes improve performance.

label: Terrain Blending
tip: Sets the rate at which one type of terrain blends to another.

label: Texture Filtering
tip: Increases texture sharpness, particularly for textures viewed at an angle. Decrease to improve performance.

label: Texture Resolution
tip: Controls the level of all texture detail. Decreasing this may slightly improve performance.

label: View Distance
tip: Changes how far you can see. Decreasing this may greatly improve performance.

label: Weather Intensity
tip: Controls the intensity of weather effects. Decrease to improve performance.

label: Ambience volume
tip: Adjusts the ambient sound volume.

label: Ambient Sounds
tip: Enable ambient sounds.

label: Death Knight Voices
tip: Special voice modulation effects for Death Knights. Disable to improve performance.

label: Emote Sounds
tip: Toggles emote sounds on and off.

label: Enable Pet Sounds
tip: Toggles pet idle and aggro sounds on and off.

label: Enable Reverb
tip: Enables reverb sound effects. This will affect performance.

label: Enable Sound
tip: Enables or disables all sound.

label: Error Speech
tip: Enables speech from errors (e.g. "Target out of range").

label: Headphone mode
tip: Enables software emulation for headphone surround sound.

label: Loop Music
tip: Enable to continuously play background music.

label: Master Volume
tip: Adjusts the master sound volume.

label: Music
tip: Enable background music.

label: Music volume
tip: Adjusts the background music volume.

label: Sound volume
tip: Adjusts the sound effect volume.

label: Sound at Character
tip: Listen to sound from the character's point of view rather than the camera.

label: Sound Channels
tip: Changes the number of active software sound channels.

label: Sound Effects
tip: Enables or disables game sound effects.

label: Sound in Background
tip: Enable to allow sounds to play even when World of Warcraft is in the background.

label: Sound Quality
tip: Adjusts the quality of game sounds. Decrease to improve performance.

label: Use Hardware
tip: Enables the use of hardware for 3D sound management. This may alter your sound performance.
